profile: margin of separating hyperplane: For a separating hyperplane, the margin is the width of the buffer zone confined between two evenly spaced translates of the hyperplane that just touch each respective class. The margin length is the distance between those evenly spaced translates, and it serves as a reasonable standard for judging the quality of such hyperplanes.
